exposure: Rural hospitals stratified by trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) rate
access to trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
outcome: Availability of prenatal and delivery care services
Access to trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC)
cohort: Pregnant women in rural Michigan, using 2015 Medicaid claims data
finding: Maternity care services, particularly access to TOLAC, are limited for many rural Michigan women, highlighting significant geographic disparities in access to care.
mod_finding: Access to trial of labor after cesarean (TOLAC) was limited for many rural Michigan women, with only two rural hospitals billing for the expected rate of TOLAC births.
